dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain the career-research situation, bounded proposal, and next action after twenty seconds?
Does the README use the target's question, budgets, handoff, storage, and proposal boundaries rather than generic agent language?
Are repository facts, planned work, manual observations, private evidence, and unknowns clearly separated?
Do descriptive headings, selective bold anchors, and link text recover the situation, mechanism, boundary, and next action?
Does each raster image explain one distinct idea without extra text, decorative pseudo-text, or unsupported capability cues?
Do the hero and supporting image remain legible and useful when stacked or cropped on a narrow screen?
Does the package keep personal evidence and proposals in private FOSSIL and avoid exposing private captures or credentials?

decision_rule: Accept only when claim_safety and privacy_boundary pass, every must_preserve sentence is stated verbatim, both raster records validate, and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review remains authoritative for honesty and usefulness.
